messages:
ben (Sales): Hey team — large fintech prospect asking for dedicated pool + burst window for embeddings-heavy inference. They expect 250 reqs/s peak for 15m windows, 4k tokens avg per request. Need rough sizing and can we support soft SLA of 200ms p95 for generation?

maria (PM): Thanks @ben. Can you share expected QPS distribution and whether they need synchronous realtime vs async? Also any retention/PII constraints?

ben (Sales): Mostly synchronous calls (user-facing), some background batch embedding jobs at night. Data is PII but can be tokenized; they need VPC for Private later. No long retention.

kevin (Infra): Quick calc: 250 req/s * 4000 tokens = 1,000,000 tokens/s. With our current A100 perf (approx 45k tokens/s single model fp16 w/ batching) -> ~22 GPUs sustained. For p95 200ms we need lower batching and some headroom. For burst 15m probably provision 30 GPUs and autoscale down to 8 min.

shweta (SRE): +1 on headroom. Also recommend KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts — that cuts tokens/s a lot for interactive flows. What's the model family? Small vs Llama-70b changes numbers.

ben (Sales): They want a 13B-quality open model (Llama2-13b / Falcon-40b-lite). Prioritize cost but need consistent latency.

kevin (Infra): For 13B-like perf assume ~60% of the A100 throughput -> adjust: ~37 GPUs sustained, 50 GPUs for burst. Proposed autoscaling policy (draft):

```
# autoscale policy
min_replicas: 8
max_replicas: 50
scale_metric: "token_rate"
target_tokens_per_gpu: 45000
cooldown: 90s
burst_buffer: 20%  # reserve for sudden spike
```

maria (PM): Nice. Can we translate that to committed vs burst pricing for Dedicated? Sales needs a number for customer: committed baseline + burst credits. Suggest commit 16 GPUs monthly and allow burst pool of +34 GPUs billed on usage.

shweta (SRE): Add acceptance criteria: p95 <= 200ms for 90% of traffic during normal hours, fallbacks to smaller model for degraded state, and circuit-breaker to async queue if sustained >5min at max scale.

kevin (Infra): Also ops checklist: monitoring on token_rate, queue_depth, per-model latency, and cost alarms at 75% of budgeted burst spend. Add canary rollouts for model changes.

maria (PM): I'll create a product backlog item (pr:dedicated/fintech-embeddings-scope) with launch criteria: sizing doc, autoscale policy, billing model, security (VPC + KMS), and runbook. @ben please attach customer SLO request and procurement timeline.

ben (Sales): Will do — sending SLAs and expected start date (Q3). If we can get a quick 2-week pilot with 8 GPUs and ramp to burst, that might help close. :thumbsup:

capacity-bot: Created intake ticket PROD-4521 for "fintech embeddings dedicated sizing" (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-4521)

maria (PM): Great, tagging eng for prioritization in next roadmap sync. Thanks everyone."
